en.headline: Help unit for residents abroad logs over 3,000 cases in eight months
en.dek: The Immigration Department said requests rose about 35 per cent from a year earlier, driven mainly by the Middle East conflict early this year; about half of the remaining cases involved lost travel documents.
body: The Immigration Department’s Assistance to Hong Kong Residents Unit received more than 3,000 requests for help in the first eight months of this year, about 35 per cent more than in the same period last year, Director of Immigration Benson Kwok said on Saturday.

Kwok said the increase was mainly linked to the military conflict in the Middle East at the start of the year. Of the remaining cases, about half involved lost travel documents. He reminded travellers to keep passports secure, saying replacements take time and many countries will not allow departure without one.

He also advised residents to buy travel insurance before going abroad, saying policies can cover costly medical evacuation if an accident occurs. The unit’s 24-hour 1868 hotline, mobile app, WhatsApp and WeChat channels remain the main routes for people who need help outside Hong Kong.

Separately, Kwok said the department is studying the use of artificial intelligence to speed up visa processing. The first stage is planned for higher-volume categories, including student visas and visas for foreign domestic helpers.

zh.headline: 協助在外港人小組首8個月接逾3000宗求助
zh.dek: 入境處處長郭俊峯表示數字較去年同期升約三成半，主要與年初中東衝突有關；其餘個案約一半涉及遺失旅行證件。
body: 入境事務處處長郭俊峯周六表示，「協助在外香港居民小組」今年首8個月接獲三千多宗求助，較去年同期上升約三成半。
他指升幅主要與年初中東軍事衝突有關。其餘求助之中，約一半涉及遺失旅行證件。他提醒市民外遊時妥善保管證件，因補領需時，不少國家在失去護照後不允許出境。
郭俊峯又呼籲出發前購買旅遊保險，一旦發生意外，可處理昂貴的醫療運送開支。身處外地的香港居民可透過1868二十四小時熱線、入境處流動應用程式、WhatsApp或微信求助。
另外，他表示入境處正研究引入人工智能優化簽證審批，縮短處理時間，計劃先用於申請量較多的類別，包括學生簽證及外籍家庭傭工簽證。
